For the fourteen days leading to qualification on SE-0061-08-05T07:29:58, Wei will make Team Fujin's existing training cycle primarily Chunin Examination preparation, emphasizing qualification readiness, field-evaluation readiness, and adaptation to unfamiliar village doctrines.
records.resolution_summary: Fourteen-day Chunin preparation priority fulfilled. Wei gives Team Fujin a final instructor briefing and sends Kai, Mei and Riku forward for qualification.

records.summary: Wei will maintain Fujin on a permanent 34-hour seven-day cycle when duties permit: five 6-hour blocks, one 4-hour taper, one recovery day. Zhu and Linh alternate supervision. Priority is coordination, tactics, awareness, survival, stealth and movement before role techniques. Wei participates selectively so the team must solve problems without him. Missions, injury and exams supersede training; missed hours are not stacked.
records.resolution_summary: Superseded by Wei's permanent 48-hour Team Fujin development policy: 34 shared team hours plus 14 individualized supervised hours, with recovery and duty overrides preserved.

records.summary: Wei will maintain Black Hound on a permanent 34-hour seven-day cycle when mission tempo permits: five 6-hour blocks, one 4-hour taper, one recovery day. Zhu and Linh alternate supervision. Priority is team coordination, investigation, counter-ambush work, stealth, capture/extraction and specialist integration. Hayama develops deputy command; each specialist keeps a dedicated lane. Wei joins selected command/opposition blocks. Missions and injury supersede training; missed hours are not stacked.
records.resolution_summary: Superseded by Wei's permanent 48-hour Black Hound development policy: 34 shared cell hours plus 14 individualized specialist hours, with recovery and mission overrides preserved.

records.summary: Wei will keep total training normally in the 34-40 hour weekly band and below the 48-hour hard cap, with 8-hour recovery between sessions. Shared team work supplies most volume. Private work uses two 4-hour blocks: one rotates through team coordination, leadership, investigation, tracking, traps and sensing/hand-seal weaknesses; one maintains high-end sword, Wind and movement integration. His elite sword, grappling, coordination and awareness stay on maintenance unless a mission exposes a gap.
records.resolution_summary: Superseded by Wei's permanent global 48-hour development policy across Fujin and Black Hound, with 34 compatible shared hours plus 14 individualized weakness-focused hours and no cross-team double counting.

records.summary: Wei will run House field training within Sword Manor's 32-slot limit by staggering House cohorts and exact teams. During Fujin or Black Hound blocks, no more than 22 House trainees use the shared training capacity; full House blocks use the remaining windows. Zhu and Linh alternate instruction, and teaching is not treated as personal development. Wei will reserve protected master-practice windows for each when they choose to use them; Zhu retains Head-of-House and dojo authority. House field elements keep the 34-hour quality cycle when duties permit.

Wei will reserve weekly master-development windows for Zhu and Linh: two 6-hour personal-practice blocks each plus one 4-hour reciprocal sparring and technical-integration block open to both. Teaching Team Fujin, Black Hound or House cohorts never counts as their personal progression. When one master teaches, the other has first claim on protected practice time. Exact training targets remain each master's choice; Zhu may override the schedule as Head of House, and lawful duties, injury or recovery needs supersede it.
